The package boost-config is compatible with built-in CMake targets of FindBoost.cmake:

    find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS config)
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE Boost::config)

or the generated cmake configs via:

    find_package( REQUIRED CONFIG)
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE Boost::config)

The package boost-mp11 is compatible with built-in CMake targets of FindBoost.cmake:

    find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS mp11)
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE Boost::mp11)

or the generated cmake configs via:

    find_package( REQUIRED CONFIG)
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE Boost::mp11)

pybind11 provides CMake targets. There are two modes provided; classic, which is built on the old Python
discovery packages in CMake, or the new FindPython mode, which uses FindPython
from 3.12+ forward (3.15+ _highly_ recommended).

New FindPython mode:

    find_package(Python COMPONENTS Interpreter Development)
    find_package(pybind11 CONFIG)

    # pybind11 method:
    pybind11_add_module(MyModule1 src1.cpp)

    # Python method:
    Python_add_library(MyModule2 src2.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(MyModule2 pybind11::headers)
    set_target_properties(MyModule2 PROPERTIES
        INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION ON
        CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET ON
        VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON
    )

For more information see here:
    https://pybind11.readthedocs.io/en/latest/compiling.html#building-with-cmake
